actions.name: code-review
actions.prompt: Review PR {url} ({key}: "{title}", linked ticket: {ticketRef}). Fetch the diff and description via gh; if a ticket is linked, check its acceptance criteria. Deliver your findings to me in this session — do not post anything to GitHub; I will submit the review myself.

actions.name: validate
actions.prompt: /brainstorm in grounded mode: validate PR {url} ({key}: "{title}", linked ticket: {ticketRef}) against its acceptance criteria; I will perform all external actions myself.

actions.name: fix-ci
actions.prompt: PR {url} ({key}: "{title}") has failing CI. Check out the branch with gh pr checkout, run gh pr checks, pull the failing run logs, diagnose, and fix. Commit locally only — do not push or comment anywhere; hand the result to me.

actions.name: start-work
actions.prompt: /brainstorm in grounded mode: start work on ticket {key}: "{title}" ({url}) — read the ticket and its acceptance criteria first. Do not claim or transition the ticket; I will.

actions.name: work-on
actions.prompt: You are picking up work item {key}: "{title}" ({url}). Investigate the current state and address what needs attention.
